note: On the Spray Lakes Reservoir in Spray Valley PP, 16 km south of Canmore on the Smith-Dorrien/Spray Trail (Hwy 742). A reservoir: the water line drops well below the campground early in the season. Run by Cedar & Spruce Campgrounds; firewood from the campground manager. Hand boat launch; a hiker-cyclist area by the entrance (July 5 - September 15). Bring drinking water: the hand pump is non-potable. --Claude
summary: Agency page confirms C$31 unserviced, 63 sites, FCFS, season May 14 - Sep 13 (stored approximate 05-15..09-15 corrected), vault toilets, non-potable pump; operator Cedar & Spruce; lakefront -> lakeview recommended (reservoir drawdown, typical water line out past an exposed beach).
flags: Waterfront: stored lakefront - RECOMMEND lakeview (judgement call). The agency map (tear sheet, updated April 2025) puts the lake-side sites (even 4-18 and 53-63, on the shore side of the loop) along the 'High Water Line', with a broad beach band and a separate 'Typical Water Line' further out (scaled from the map, about 100-130 m beyond the pads). Esri imagery dated 2024-06-13 shows the reservoir drawn down: from the lake-side pads (~50.9908,-115.3708) an open grass then bare-lakebed flat runs ~300-400 m to the water. So the shore-side sites are on the water only near full pool; at the agency's typical level and early season they look across 100 m+ of exposed lakebed. Open ground, unscreened view: lakeview is the floor. Agency wording: 'many of which are very close to the lake'.
